basic_info.description:
Immaculate upgraded top floor flat (approximately 1720 sq. ft.) of the duplex, located in prime Cow Hollow neighborhood.

Expansive living room w/decorative fireplace, large windows, formal dining room, remodeled kitchen w/stainless-steel appliances, tile floor and abundance of cabinetry, high ceilings, gleaming hardwood floors in living room, dining room and hallway area. Two large bedrooms have beautiful views of the Palace of Fine Arts, Bay, peak of the GG Bridge, Marin Headlands. Remodeled bathroom with shower over tub. Shared laundry in building. Private parking in garage and abundant of storage in garage. Large private yard with huge fig trees. 

Close to Presidio Park, Palace of Fine Arts Park, and the Palace of Fine Arts. A stroll from the Lyon Street Stairs, Chestnut St, Union Street shops & restaurants, and easy access to Muni and northbound 101 Freeway.

Owner pays: water & garbage. Tenant pays: PG&E, internet/cable. Small pets are negotiable with an additional deposit. No smoke allowed.
